groups.facts: One horizontal bar with its left end attached to a hatched vertical support. Bar extends right to one closed free end. Both force arrows lie along the bar interior, not outside it.

Two solid horizontal arrows point inward: reaction F1 = -F points right from near the support, and applied vector F points left from the right end. Printed labels above the bar retain the vector relation. No dimensions, axis, numeric data, dashed line or additional subfigure.
